overview: The BMP180 measures barometric pressure and temperature; its successor, the BME280, adds humidity sensing too, and both talk over a standard I2C bus rather than the DHT sensors' proprietary timing protocol — a much easier, faster, and more reliable interface. Pressure sensing is the more surprising use case for beginners: because atmospheric pressure decreases predictably with altitude, this sensor can estimate elevation change (useful in drones and weather stations) accurately enough to detect a few meters of height difference, using the same physics as an aircraft altimeter.
simpleSummary: A sensor that reads temperature, humidity, and air pressure, and reports them over a simple digital connection.

specifications.interface: I2C (default address 0x76 or 0x77), SPI on some breakouts
specifications.humidity: BME280 only — BMP180 has no humidity sensing
specifications.altitudeEstimation: Derived from pressure using the barometric formula, accurate to a few meters

pinMap.name: VCC
pinMap.currentLimit: ~1-4 µA in sleep, ~714 µA during measurement

pinMap.name: CSB
pinMap.function: Chip select — tie HIGH for I2C mode (the default on most breakouts), drive as active-LOW select for SPI mode.

pinMap.name: SDO
pinMap.function: In I2C mode, selects the address (LOW=0x76, HIGH=0x77). In SPI mode, acts as the data output (MISO).
pinMap.gotcha: Never leave floating — an undefined I2C address makes the sensor unreliable to detect.

useCases.title: Weather station
useCases.scenario: Track pressure trends over time to give a simple 'storm coming' style forecast alongside temperature/humidity.

useCases.title: Drone altitude hold
useCases.scenario: Use pressure-derived altitude as one input to a flight controller's altitude-hold mode.

useCases.title: Indoor climate monitor
useCases.scenario: Combine pressure, temperature, and (on BME280) humidity into a single small sensor for a smart-home dashboard.

oftenConfusedWith: DHT11/DHT22 (proprietary single-wire protocol, no pressure sensing)
oftenUpgradedTo: BME680 (adds gas/air-quality sensing to the same package)
